title: Zip Arrays
prompt: A table builder receives separate columns and needs row pairs. Write a function that combines two arrays into pairs, stopping when the shorter array runs out.

explanation.beginner:
Example: zipArrays([1,2], ["a","b"]) produces [[1,"a"],[2,"b"]]. The result must follow this precise rule: A table builder receives separate columns and needs row pairs. Write a function that combines two arrays into pairs, stopping when the shorter array runs out. Work with one argument at a time and distinguish the values that select a branch from the values returned by that branch.

Compare “stops at shorter arrays”: input [[1,2,3],["a"]] produces [[1,"a"]]. Explain which rule causes the difference before writing code.
